config.json._comment: tracked base, colocated with guard.mjs -- portable fields only, the same on every machine

config.<profile>.json._comment: tracked per-machine overlay, colocated with guard.mjs -- <profile> is GUARDS_PROFILE if set, else the lowercased hostname. Shallow-merged over config.json at read time; GUARDS_CONFIG bypasses this whole file pair and points at one fully-resolved config instead.
